pairings.why_it_works: Each repeat inherits the tremolo contour, so the echo rhythm gains internal accents without extra taps.
pairings.caution: Fast tremolo and multiple heads can create a crowded composite rhythm; simplify one stage first.

insider_note: Documented: at high Dynamics tremolo may appear mainly near a note’s tail; very slow Speed can land attacks in silence.
avoid_when: Use Lion Head for pitch motion, Model 84 Chorus for ensemble spread, or Fix Phaser for moving spectral notches.

name: Vocal Tuner
comparative_edge: Choose it over offline note editing when low-latency automatic correction, MIDI targets, and creative octave/formant voices must happen in real time. Unlike Vocoder, it preserves the singer as the carrier; unlike Model 72 Envelope Filter, it changes intonation rather than tone.

advanced_moves.setup: Monophonic lead vocal, correct key/scale.
advanced_moves.action: Mark intentional blue Bypass notes first, tune with Modern/slow transitions, then increase Retune only where pitch center remains vague.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Stable centers with preserved scoops/vibrato.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Bypass protects intentional notes; Modern maintains formants.

advanced_moves.setup: Parallel generated harmony layer.
advanced_moves.action: Lower Dry/Wet, add one octave, use Sweeten/Pan Spread, then automate Shift/Formant only on ad-libs.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A separate designed layer without thinning the lead.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Octave voices have independent gain and detune/formant spread.

use_cases.application: Use Low Latency with conservative Retune and Transition.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: It reports under 1 ms and shows raw/target/corrected pitch.

use_cases.application: Blend octave/formant voices only on phrase ends.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Correction and creative voices share one monophonic detector.

insider_note: Documented: Default range detects to about C2; Extended Low is needed below. Low Latency reports under 1 ms.
avoid_when: Use offline editing for polyphonic material or surgical note-by-note timing; use Vocoder when carrier resynthesis is the goal.

name: Vocoder
comparative_edge: Choose it over Vocal Tuner when speech envelopes should resynthesize a six-voice carrier rather than correct pitch. Compared with Buchla 296e, it supplies an integrated MIDI carrier, unvoiced consonant section, chord transposition, and clocked Freeze without building a modular patch.

advanced_moves.setup: Spoken vocal modulator plus MIDI carrier notes.
advanced_moves.action: Start at 20 bands, calibrate Unvoiced Sensitivity for s/t sounds, then reduce bands and lengthen Shape until words are barely clear.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Chosen intelligibility with consonants still legible.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Bands set analysis resolution; unvoiced noise restores plosives.

advanced_moves.setup: Rhythmic loop as modulator.
advanced_moves.action: Choose noise/pulse carrier, clock Freeze to a subdivision, raise Emphasis cautiously, and automate Spectral Tilt.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A pitched rhythmic texture with stable captured formants.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Freeze stores band states while the carrier supplies harmonics.

use_cases.application: Use 12–20 bands and tuned saw carrier, then blend dry.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More intelligible and immediate than building 296e resynthesis.

use_cases.application: Drive a held chord from drum envelopes and clock Freeze on fills.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Integrated carrier and Freeze make the transfer session-ready.

insider_note: Documented: in the mono plug-in, increasing Stereo Width leaves only even bands; high Emphasis can create clipping transients.
avoid_when: Use Vocal Tuner to preserve the original voice, or Buchla 296e when individual band envelopes/CV routing are the point.

name: Model 72 Envelope Filter
comparative_edge: Choose it over Mutronics Mutator for one focused ladder-filter envelope effect with modeled drive and a simpler Fast/Smooth response. Choose Mutator when dual stereo filters, external sidechain contours, gating, or LFO motion matter.

advanced_moves.setup: Bass insert with consistent input gain.
advanced_moves.action: Set Drive first, tune Cutoff/Resonance, then raise Smooth envelope depth until attacks open without losing fundamental; blend dry.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Velocity-shaped brightness with stable low note weight.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Follower amplitude controls the modeled ladder cutoff.

advanced_moves.setup: Parallel drum filter.
advanced_moves.action: Use Fast mode and higher resonance, print wet, then gate/slice only selected hits.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Percussive filter pings rather than continuous wah.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Fast following reacts to transients; resonance emphasizes swept cutoff.

use_cases.application: Use Smooth follower and parallel dry for low-end continuity.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Simpler and more tonally focused than Mutator.

use_cases.application: Print Fast resonant sweeps on selected hits.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: The ladder/drive identity turns envelopes into a voice.

insider_note: Engineering inference: follower presets are level-dependent, so input trim is part of the patch and must be recalibrated across sources.
avoid_when: Use Mutronics Mutator for external sidechain, stereo-linked LFOs, gate mode, or separate VCA/VCF modulation.

name: Mutronics Mutator
comparative_edge: Choose it over Model 72 Envelope Filter when two filters must follow internal or external envelopes, switch to gate behavior, or move from linked/inverted LFOs. Its separate VCF/VCA destinations make it a rhythmic reshaper as much as a filter.

advanced_moves.setup: Piano bus with drum sidechain.
advanced_moves.action: Select EXT, calibrate Sensitivity to peak LED brightness, smooth Release, sweep VCF only, and blend dry.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Drum rhythm imposed on piano tone without chopped level.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: External envelope drives cutoff while VCA stays bypassed.

advanced_moves.setup: Stereo pad insert.
advanced_moves.action: Link LFOs inverted, choose Both, set different cutoffs per side, and sync rate to host.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Opposing stereo breathing without center disappearance.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Inverted linked LFO drives channels in opposite phase.

use_cases.application: Use EXT envelope on VCF and tune Attack/Release to groove.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Model 72 lacks this dual-channel external control.

use_cases.application: Link/invert LFOs and modulate VCF plus VCA gently.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: One processor coordinates stereo filter and amplitude motion.

insider_note: Documented: Tempo Sync disables both free Rate knobs; high Resonance self-oscillates and Width extends beyond hard-left/right through M/S.
avoid_when: Use Model 72 Envelope Filter for one quick mono ladder-following sound; Mutator is excessive when no stereo/sidechain/gate logic is needed.

name: Model 72 Synth System
comparative_edge: Choose it over Model 82 for a three-oscillator, feedback-capable monophonic architecture and over Model 80/84 when chord polyphony is unnecessary. It uniquely spans instrument, external-audio FX, Modular components, and Amp Room filter roles.

advanced_moves.setup: Init bass patch.
advanced_moves.action: Balance oscillators below obvious overload, set filter contour, then introduce modeled output-to-external feedback and re-trim mixer levels.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Extra harmonics and compression without lost fundamental.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Feedback and mixer level jointly drive filter/amp nonlinearity.

advanced_moves.setup: Model 72 FX on drums.
advanced_moves.action: Feed drums to the external input, use Auto-Gate for input-triggered envelopes or disable it and send MIDI gates, then print cutoff and contour rides.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A played resonant layer tracking drum energy.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The FX plug-in routes external audio through the modeled mixer, four-pole filter, and amp while Auto-Gate or MIDI opens its envelopes.

use_cases.application: Use three oscillators and restrained feedback for a performance patch.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Richer oscillator interaction than Model 82.

use_cases.application: Drive external audio through Model 72 FX and print resonance rides.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its dedicated FX version and component modules extend beyond a fixed synth.

insider_note: Documented: the product installs instrument and FX plug-ins, seven Modular modules, and an Amp Room filter; feedback models the hardware output-to-input trick.
avoid_when: Use Model 82 for internal sequencing/arpeggiation or Model 84/80 for polyphonic chords.

name: Model 77 Dual Layer Synth
comparative_edge: Choose it over Model 80/84 when two independently voiced layers, serial resonant high/low-pass filters, polyphonic aftertouch, and unusual sustain/glide behavior matter more than familiar subtractive immediacy.

advanced_moves.setup: Two-layer pad.
advanced_moves.action: Use contrasting HPF/LPF windows, retain sine below one layer, detune minimally, then map polyphonic pressure to that layer's VCF while keeping global LFO aftertouch restrained.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Per-note expression without losing low anchor.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The sine level bypasses the VCF, and the layer VCF pressure destination can respond per note; LFO aftertouch remains global.

advanced_moves.setup: Long-release sequence.
advanced_moves.action: Compare Sustain I/II while adding glide, then print the behavior before changing allocation settings.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Released notes either hold pitch or follow the last note as intended.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The two sustain modes sample released-voice pitch differently.

use_cases.application: Stack complementary layers and articulate individual notes with pressure.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Model 80/84 fall back to channel-wide expression.

use_cases.application: Exploit Sustain II/glide to retune released voices.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its allocation behavior creates motion unavailable in conventional polys.

pairings.goal: Automate its characteristic space independently from the synth's linked reverb macro.
pairings.order: Model 77 Dual Layer Synth → Model 77 Reverb
pairings.setup: Reduce the instrument's reverb, send to the separate module fully wet, and ride decay separately from send level.
pairings.why_it_works: The extracted effect retains the intended vocabulary while exposing independent decay and mix behavior.
pairings.caution: Avoid double-processing through both reverb paths unless the extra density is deliberate.

insider_note: Documented: active gated notes are not stolen; excess notes wait and are prioritized high-to-low when a voice frees.
avoid_when: Use Model 84 for immediate single-DCO chorus pads or Model 80 for five-voice dual-oscillator modulation.

name: Model 80 Five Voice Synthesizer
comparative_edge: Choose it over Model 84 for dual oscillators, oscillator sync, and per-voice modulation; choose Model 77 when layers/poly-aftertouch are central. Model 80’s global and per-voice buses produce movement that changes from note to note.

advanced_moves.setup: Init poly patch.
advanced_moves.action: Set Oscillator 2 non-keyboard/low-frequency, route it through Voice Mod to cutoff or Osc1 pulse width, then add only light global LFO.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Each voice moves differently without chorus smear.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Osc2 modulation runs per voice; global LFO affects all voices together.

advanced_moves.setup: Self-oscillating filter patch.
advanced_moves.action: Raise resonance past oscillation, engage keyboard tracking, quantize cutoff if desired, then excite with short envelopes.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Tuned sine-like notes with modeled envelope overshoot.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The filter tracks pitch and can oscillate independently.

use_cases.application: Use per-voice Osc2 modulation for evolving chords.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More note-to-note variation than Model 84.

use_cases.application: Play the self-oscillating tracked filter with short envelopes.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Quantizable cutoff and modeled filter turn it into an alternate oscillator.

insider_note: Documented: repeated same notes reuse the same voice; the sixth held note steals according to the original five-voice allocation.
avoid_when: Use Model 84 for six-voice simplicity/chorus, Model 77 for dual layers, or Model 72 for monophonic feedback bass.

name: Model 82 Sequencing Mono Synth
comparative_edge: Choose it over Model 72 when a built-in 100-step sequencer, arpeggiator, sub-oscillator, and DAW-synced pattern workflow matter more than three-oscillator feedback architecture. Drive and Doubling extend its deliberately simple mono voice.

advanced_moves.setup: Programmed bass sequence.
advanced_moves.action: Record notes, rests, legato, and velocity; use DAW clock, then automate sequence transpose while keeping oscillator tune fixed.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Pattern variation that preserves articulation and timing.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Sequence stores legato/velocity and can transpose from keyboard input.

advanced_moves.setup: A bass sequence needs a different filter offset on every played note without drawing automation.
advanced_moves.action: Set Env Mode to LFO, slow the LFO nearly to a stop, choose RND for filter modulation, and let incoming notes reset the LFO. Tune modulation depth after the pattern is running.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Each note should hold one random cutoff state rather than sweeping continuously; reduce depth if pitch identity disappears.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Note reset samples a new point from the random waveform, turning the LFO into a note-controlled sample-and-hold source.

advanced_moves.setup: A mono lead needs a second pitched voice without adding another oscillator plug-in.
advanced_moves.action: Push filter resonance into self-oscillation, engage keyboard tracking, tune the filter against the VCO, then drive both together for controlled intermodulation.
advanced_moves.listen_for: The filter tone should follow the keyboard as a stable second voice; high input levels should add beating texture before collapsing into noise.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The tracked self-oscillating filter generates its own pitch, and Softube documents deliberate intermodulation when it is driven by the main oscillator.

use_cases.application: Use rests/legato/velocity and transpose the latched pattern live.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Model 72 lacks integrated sequence memory.

use_cases.application: Reset an ultra-slow random LFO on each note so every hit receives a held filter offset.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its note-reset behavior turns a normal LFO into a playable sample-and-hold source without extra routing.

use_cases.application: Tune the self-oscillating tracked filter against the VCO, then raise mixer level for controlled intermodulation.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: The filter becomes a second pitched source inside a nominally single-oscillator synth.

pairings.goal: Turn the internal sequencer into a clean antiphonal pattern.
pairings.order: Model 82 Sequencing Mono Synth → Stereo Delay
pairings.setup: Choose one short synced division against the sequence, use low feedback, and automate send on selected steps.
pairings.why_it_works: The mono sequence stays centered while the delay creates a second rhythmic voice at the sides.
pairings.caution: Avoid equal delay and sequence periods if every repeat merely masks the next note.

insider_note: Softube labels these as hidden features: note-reset can turn the random LFO into sample-and-hold, while the keyboard-tracked self-oscillating filter can act as a second oscillator and intermodulate with the VCO.
avoid_when: Use Model 72 for three oscillators/feedback or a poly model for chords; Model 82 is strictly monophonic.

name: Model 84 Polyphonic Synthesizer
comparative_edge: Choose it over Model 80 for faster single-DCO/sub/filter/chorus programming and six voices; choose Model 80 for dual-oscillator/per-voice modulation. Model 84’s Poly 1/Poly 2 allocation and fixed chorus define performance as much as its oscillator.

advanced_moves.setup: Poly pad.
advanced_moves.action: Build pulse/sub tone, use slow PWM, set Poly 1 for overlap, then compare Chorus I/II and stereo only after filter envelope is stable.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Motion without masking chord attack.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: PWM animates the source; chorus adds a second modulation layer afterward.

advanced_moves.setup: Gliding chord/mono line.
advanced_moves.action: Switch Poly 2 for predictable glide or Unison for six-voice mono, then tune expanded detune/velocity response.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Consistent glide assignment or focused stacked lead.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Voice modes change allocation rather than only note count.

advanced_moves.setup: Build a playable electronic hi-hat patch instead of starting from a drum sample.
advanced_moves.action: Use the noise source with zero Attack, short Decay, zero Sustain, and a longer Release. Release notes before the decay finishes for open hats; hold notes past the decay for closed hats, then tune the filter and resonance.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Open and closed articulation should come from note length, with one consistent timbre rather than two disconnected samples.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Softube documents the envelope's note-off timing as a way to switch between short closed-hat and longer open-hat behavior.

use_cases.application: Use Poly 1, PWM, and Chorus I for overlapping chords.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Faster and wider than Model 80 without external effects.

use_cases.application: Stack six voices, control detune, and disable chorus if center focus matters.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Hardware-style combined voice mode gives a distinct mono response.

use_cases.application: Shape noise with a zero-attack, short-decay envelope and use played note length to select closed or open articulation.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: One synthesized patch produces continuously related hat articulations instead of switching samples.

pairings.goal: Move the instrument's modeled chorus into a controllable parallel or insert stage.
pairings.order: Model 84 Polyphonic Synthesizer → Model 84 Chorus
pairings.setup: Reduce the internal chorus, route the synth through the separate module, then compare Chorus I and II at matched loudness.
pairings.why_it_works: The dedicated module preserves the family character while supporting routing the synth panel does not expose.
pairings.caution: Do not count louder/wider as better; level-match and mono-check both modes.

insider_note: Documented second identity: above roughly 9 resonance, the keyboard-tracked filter self-oscillates and becomes a pitched oscillator. Half tracking creates six chromatic steps per octave for deliberately dissonant organ or drone overtones.
avoid_when: Use Model 80 for oscillator sync/per-voice modulation or Model 77 for layered/poly-aftertouch performance.

name: Statement Lead
comparative_edge: Choose it over Model synths when two curated hardware-derived waveform sources, a dirt layer, modulation sequencer, auto-glide, and finished lead effects matter more than oscillator-level reconstruction. Choose Parallels for deeper modulation/shaper architecture.

advanced_moves.setup: Two-source lead.
advanced_moves.action: Pair contrasting A/B categories, detune B by interval, route transient Dirt outside the filter, then sequence cutoff rather than source level.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A defined attack above an evolving harmonic body.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Dirt can bypass filtering while both pitched sources share it.

advanced_moves.setup: Expressive chord lead.
advanced_moves.action: Trigger Auto-glide from velocity/aftertouch only above performance threshold, then set Punch/Release around the gesture.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Pitch movement appears on accented events, not every note.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Auto-glide supports conditional onset/release triggers.

use_cases.application: Combine two recorded sources and use internal sequencing/effects to occupy a mix slot quickly.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Model synths need more downstream production.

use_cases.application: Map Auto-glide to aftertouch or velocity accents.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its trigger logic makes glides playable on polyphonic material.

pairings.goal: Give an aggressive lead a warm repeat lane without softening its dry attack.
pairings.order: Statement Lead → Tube Delay on an aux
pairings.setup: Send only phrase endings, darken the delay, and set feedback below the next lead entry.
pairings.why_it_works: The dry synth keeps articulation while the tube stage rounds and separates the throws.
pairings.caution: Continuous send can turn dense lead harmonics into midrange buildup.

insider_note: Documented: Source B spans ±7 semitones and Dirt can go directly to output, bypassing the main filter.
avoid_when: Use Model 72/80/84 for oscillator/circuit-level synthesis or Parallels for four-slot multi-type modulation.

name: Monoment Bass
comparative_edge: Choose it over Model 72/82 when stereo sampled hardware sources, dirt, spatialization, and integrated multiband/EQ should deliver a produced bass quickly. Choose Parallels for broader polyphonic modulation; Monoment stays focused on bass role and mix placement.

advanced_moves.setup: Layered bass patch.
advanced_moves.action: Pair clean low source with punchy upper source, octave B if needed, route Dirt through filter, then use Aging before Drive.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Stable sub plus animated attack sharing one contour.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Sources capture different hardware envelopes/spectra; Dirt routing unifies or separates texture.

advanced_moves.setup: Stereo patch destined for club mix.
advanced_moves.action: Reduce Spatialization, mono-check, keep low source centered, then re-add upper width after multiband control.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Wide harmonics with unchanged mono fundamental.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Recorded sources may already be stereo before added spatial processing.

use_cases.application: Layer clean sub and punch source, then finish with internal multiband/EQ.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Faster than building and processing a Model synth stack.

use_cases.application: Use sampled analog Dirt outside filter against a moving filtered source.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Dirt can retain attacks/noise independently of tonal filtering.

pairings.goal: Animate the upper bass in stereo while protecting the mono fundamental.
pairings.order: Monoment Bass → parallel Mutronics Mutator
pairings.setup: High-pass the Mutator branch, use restrained envelope following, and blend beneath a centered dry bass.
pairings.why_it_works: The dedicated bass synth supplies weight; the dual filter creates movement only where stereo information is safer.
pairings.caution: Sum to mono and verify the filtered branch does not cancel essential harmonics.

insider_note: Documented: Aging controls the sampled Analog Dirt amount; Dirt can bypass the main filter and enter effects directly.
avoid_when: Use Model 72/82 for continuously generated oscillators and performance sequencing, or Parallels for polyphonic experimental layers.

name: Parallels
comparative_edge: Choose it over Statement/Monoment when two recorded multi-waveform layers need LPG/SVF/Resonator shaping and four freely assigned LFO, random, Euclidean, envelope, or step modulators. Choose Model synths when circuit continuity and simpler cause/effect matter.

advanced_moves.setup: Two-layer evolving pad.
advanced_moves.action: Use contrasting waves, separate Color envelopes, LPG on one layer and Resonator on the other, then route one slow Random mod to both at opposite depths.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Related motion with distinct layer identities.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Independent source scanning/shapers share modulators without sharing response.

advanced_moves.setup: Rhythmic texture patch.
advanced_moves.action: Put Euclidean and step modulators in separate Mod Pod slots, route one to Color and one to effect mix, and leave amp envelopes simple.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Rhythm in timbre/effects without retriggering every note.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Mod Pod destinations operate beyond pitch and amplitude.

advanced_moves.setup: A held source needs tremolo or irregular chopping without using the amp envelope as the obvious destination.
advanced_moves.action: Turn one Source off and modulate the layer Mix with an LFO, or choose a waveform with a late-start silent region and modulate playback position across it. Shape the LFO after the rhythm works.
advanced_moves.listen_for: The amplitude rhythm should come from moving between sound and silence, with timbre changing differently from a normal VCA tremolo.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Softube documents both routes: Mix modulation against a disabled layer, and playback modulation across a waveform's silent start region.

use_cases.application: Cross-shape source scans through LPG and Resonator.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Deeper layer modulation than Statement/Monoment.

use_cases.application: Modulate Color and effects with independent rhythmic sources.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Four multi-type slots make rhythm independent of MIDI notes.

use_cases.application: Sweep a late-start waveform between its silent and sounding regions, or modulate Mix against a disabled layer.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its source architecture turns waveform position and layer balance into unconventional amplitude processors.

insider_note: Documented hidden modulation: assign a Mod Pod LFO to the Flanger's own LFO speed or to Delay speed for an unusual nested-modulation flange rather than a conventional sweep.
avoid_when: Use Statement for faster finished leads, Monoment for dedicated bass, or Model synths for component-modeled oscillator behavior.

name: Heartbeat
comparative_edge: Choose it over samples when eight drum voices must change pitch/envelope continuously and feed integrated Filter Echo, TSAR-1D, Dyna-mite, Auto Layer, and multiple outputs. Choose Modular for unrestricted patching; Heartbeat keeps synthesis and routing optimized for a kit.

advanced_moves.setup: Eight-voice kit with separate outputs.
advanced_moves.action: Tune voices in context, route kick/snare separately, keep sends on main bus, and compare effect Pre before committing Dyna-mite processing.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Independent mix control without detached shared tails.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Multiple outputs and selectable pre/post dynamics alter where sends are compressed.

advanced_moves.setup: Auto Layer fill channel.
advanced_moves.action: Build a four-event flam/fill from different voices, set deterministic pattern first, then add only enough Chaos for variation.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Recognizable fill grammar with occasional mutation.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: ALM triggers layered/serial events before adding controlled randomness.

advanced_moves.setup: A snare or percussion voice needs a gated, breathing ambience without an external reverb-and-gate chain.
advanced_moves.action: Send the voice to TSAR-1D or Filter Echo, engage that effect's Pre switch, then set Dyna-mite to Gate for chopped tails or Slow compression for a pumping room. Tune Release to the groove.
advanced_moves.listen_for: The ambience should open, breathe, or disappear as part of the hit envelope while the dry drum remains intelligible.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Pre routes the shared effect return into Dyna-mite, so its gate or compressor reshapes the reverb/delay tail together with the kit bus.

use_cases.application: Automate synthesis parameters and route key voices separately.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Continuous drum modeling exceeds static sample switching.

use_cases.application: Create four-step cross-voice fills with restrained Chaos.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Pattern layering is integrated with the kit and MIDI mapping.

use_cases.application: Place TSAR-1D or Filter Echo before Dyna-mite, then gate or compress the return as part of the kit envelope.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: The internal Pre routing turns its shared ambience into a dynamically playable layer without extra plug-ins.

pairings.goal: Turn individual drum hits into performable dub-style feedback events.
pairings.order: Heartbeat → Tape Echoes on a send
pairings.setup: Send one or two voices rather than the full kit, use filtered one-head repeats, and ride Echoes On or feedback at transitions.
pairings.why_it_works: Heartbeat's separated synthetic voices give the tape loop clean, selective excitation.
pairings.caution: Full-kit sends quickly overload the loop and obscure kick timing.

insider_note: Documented: effect Pre places Echo/Reverb before Dyna-mite, so tails are dynamically processed. In Gate mode with Bass Drums ducking, the kick can instead key other voices into existence only on each kick hit.
avoid_when: Use samples for exact acoustic capture/round-robin libraries or Modular when every trigger and processor must be freely patched.

name: Modular
comparative_edge: Choose it over fixed Model instruments when routing itself is the composition: audio/CV interchange, feedback, utilities, and licensed modules matter more than fast recall. Choose Parallels for contained modulation; Modular is open-ended and therefore demands more gain/control discipline.

advanced_moves.setup: Small voice patch.
advanced_moves.action: Build oscillator→filter→VCA first, then place attenuators before every modulation destination and save as a reusable subpatch before adding effects.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Each added cable changes one audible dimension predictably.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Utilities constrain the otherwise unrestricted audio/CV system.

advanced_moves.setup: Modular FX on external audio.
advanced_moves.action: Split dry and processed paths, build a filtered feedback loop through Delay, then return below unity and print automation.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Evolving repeats without runaway level.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Audio-rate patching permits external loop processing but no automatic safety.

advanced_moves.setup: A single-oscillator bass patch needs octave weight without adding another tuned oscillator.
advanced_moves.action: Feed a pulse-wave oscillator into the Clock Divider and mix its /2, /4, or /8 output beneath the original before the filter. Change division between sections rather than retuning pitch.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Stable octave-down reinforcement should follow every note; reduce the divided layer if square-wave edges dominate the filter.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Softube documents the Clock Divider's utility circuit as a sub-oscillator when driven by an oscillator pulse output.

use_cases.application: Assemble only required components and map performance CV deliberately.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Fixed synths cannot change topology.

use_cases.application: Route audio through filters/delay/control-rate feedback and print.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: It treats host audio and CV inside one rack.

use_cases.application: Use fixed Clock Divider outputs as octave-down audio layers before the filter.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: A timing utility becomes a pitch-stable tone generator, adding weight without another VCO or tuning control.

insider_note: Documented utility misuse: the mathematically clean Sine Oscillator began as a development test source but doubles as a compact LFO or FM operator; the Signal Tool can compare audio levels in faux-compressor patches.
avoid_when: Use a Model synth or Parallels when fast preset recall and bounded signal flow matter more than patch architecture.

name: Vermona Random Rhythm
comparative_edge: Choose it over Modular’s fixed sequencers when probability by quarter/eighth/sixteenth/triplet division and repeatable Dice bars should be performed directly. It is a trigger generator, not a note sequencer.

advanced_moves.setup: Two percussion voices.
advanced_moves.action: Set channel 1 Dice 4/4 and channel 2 Dice 3/4, then lower probabilities and reset both at a phrase boundary.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Repeating polymetric relation with controlled mutation.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Channels can hold different bar lengths and clocks.

advanced_moves.setup: Stable kick plus random hats.
advanced_moves.action: Disable random on one division output for clock duty; keep the other channel Realtime with Offbeat hats.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Deterministic anchor under changing subdivisions.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Individual outputs can become continuous clocks while Seq remains probabilistic.

use_cases.application: Drive kick deterministically and hats from Realtime probability.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Division-specific probability is immediate.

use_cases.application: Run 4/4 against 3/4 Dice bars and reset per phrase.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Two independent rhythm engines expose this without a large patch.

insider_note: Documented: DAW quarter-pulse sync stabilizes only on the third beat, and Offbeat does not affect combined Seq Out.
avoid_when: Use a MIDI/step sequencer when exact notes, velocities, and deterministic step editing are required.

name: Buchla 296e Spectral Processor
comparative_edge: Choose it over Vocoder when sixteen band envelopes, A/B spectral drawings, Freeze memories, and external CV transfer matter more than an integrated carrier. Choose 4ms SMR for tuned resonant chords; 296e is the analysis/resynthesis and control extractor.

advanced_moves.setup: Rhythmic modulator and pad carrier.
advanced_moves.action: Feed odd/even banks separately, select one-way Spectrum Xfer, tune per-band Decay, and listen only to destination bank.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Rhythm imposed on pad with controllable release per band.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Eight source envelopes internally drive opposite-bank VCAs.

advanced_moves.setup: Audio-analysis patch.
advanced_moves.action: Freeze a transient spectrum into A, capture a sustained spectrum into B, then morph while routing selected envelope outs elsewhere.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Continuous timbre motion plus related control gestures.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: A/B memories and 16 envelope followers are independent resources.

use_cases.application: Use spectral transfer and tune band decays.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More patchable than Vocoder.

use_cases.application: Route band envelopes to unrelated filters/panning.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: It converts audio spectrum into 16 CV streams.

insider_note: Documented: panel-latched Freeze blocks other display/button edits; a single internal transfer direction is eight-band, not sixteen-band vocoding.
avoid_when: Use Vocoder for immediate MIDI-carrier speech or 4ms SMR for tuned resonant scale rotation.

name: Mutable Instruments Rings
comparative_edge: Choose it over Braids when excitation/resonance physics should remain patchable, and over 4ms SMR when one modeled body with up to four voices matters more than six scale-locked bands.

advanced_moves.setup: MIDI-to-CV plucked voice.
advanced_moves.action: Patch pitch/strum, leave In unpatched for internal excitation, map velocity to Brightness, then separate Odd/Even to stereo processing.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Dynamic plucks with contrasting partial groups.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Normalized excitation and split outputs expose model harmonics.

advanced_moves.setup: External percussion into Rings.
advanced_moves.action: Feed short hits to In, leave Strum unpatched, use long Damping and slowly modulate Position.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Input transients becoming tuned resonant drones.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Rings infers strums from In transients when other triggers are absent.

use_cases.application: Map velocity to Brightness and use four-voice strums.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More body-specific than Braids’ macro models.

use_cases.application: Use source transients as excitation for sympathetic strings.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Can infer excitation/strum without extra trigger logic.

pairings.goal: Create clock-derived strikes with a separate damping or brightness gesture.
pairings.order: PEG EOR/EOF → Rings Strum; PEG ENV → Rings Brightness or Damping CV
pairings.setup: Ping PEG from the sequence clock, patch EOR or EOF to Strum, patch an attenuated short ENV to Brightness or Damping, and leave Rings In unpatched for its internal exciter.
pairings.why_it_works: PEG's event output triggers Rings' exciter while its envelope independently shapes the resonator parameter, keeping articulation and decay control separate.
pairings.caution: Attenuate parameter CV; full-range modulation can jump between useful physical regimes.

insider_note: Documented: unpatched In/Strum/V-Oct are normalized intelligently; inserting one cable can therefore change multiple inferred behaviors.
avoid_when: Use Braids for broad oscillator algorithms or 4ms SMR for six tuned filter bands and scale rotation.

name: Doepfer A-188-1 BBD
comparative_edge: Choose it over Tape Echoes/Echoes when raw BBD clock, exposed feedback patching, and aliasing are synthesis material. Choose those native delays for finished stereo timing and safety; A-188-1 is deliberately unfiltered and rough.

advanced_moves.setup: Short chorus patch.
advanced_moves.action: Modulate Clock slightly, mix dry externally, and low-pass the delayed path before feedback.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Movement without exposed clock tone.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Clock changes delay/pitch; external filtering replaces missing dedicated chorus filtering.

advanced_moves.setup: Karplus-like feedback voice.
advanced_moves.action: Break the feedback path, insert filter/VCA, excite with one pulse, and raise feedback below runaway.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A decaying pitched metallic string.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Short BBD delay plus filtered recirculation forms a resonator.

use_cases.application: Clock-modulate and externally filter a dry/wet mix.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Exposes artifacts hidden by native delays.

use_cases.application: Process the external feedback loop with filter/VCA.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Loop send/return enables custom damping.

pairings.goal: Filter and stabilize a custom BBD feedback loop.
pairings.order: A-188-1 feedback send → Korgasmatron II → A-188-1 feedback return
pairings.setup: Start with low feedback, use one low-pass channel to remove clock energy, then raise resonance and feedback gradually.
pairings.why_it_works: The BBD deliberately lacks fixed anti-alias/reconstruction filtering; the external dual filter makes damping and coloration patchable.
pairings.caution: Self-oscillating filter resonance plus BBD feedback can run away suddenly; leave headroom and add protection.

insider_note: Documented: modeled unit uses a 1024-stage BL3207; external MHz clock I/O is omitted and clock bleed is optional.
avoid_when: Use Echoes/Tape Echoes for polished host-synced stereo delay; avoid full feedback without level protection.

name: Mutable Instruments Braids
comparative_edge: Choose it over Rings for 45 oscillator models spanning analog, digital, vocal, physical, wavetable, noise, and percussion; choose Model instruments for continuous circuit identity. Braids compresses breadth into model-specific Timbre/Color axes.

advanced_moves.setup: Single Braids voice.
advanced_moves.action: Choose one model, tune Timbre/Color by ear, then attenuate CV into only one axis before animating META.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Movement inside a coherent model before cross-model jumps.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Timbre/Color meanings change per algorithm; META repurposes FM CV for model scan.

advanced_moves.setup: Percussive model.
advanced_moves.action: Patch Trigger, enable internal envelope/VCA, lower BITS/RATE only after dynamics work, then print variations.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Defined hits with controlled digital grit.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Some models require excitation; DAC settings degrade after generation.

use_cases.application: Select a model and map Timbre/Color to performance CV.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Far broader than one Model oscillator.

use_cases.application: Use restrained META CV to move among related models.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Algorithm selection itself is modulatable.

pairings.goal: Give a broad digital oscillator model an organic coupled amplitude/spectral decay.
pairings.order: Mutable Instruments Braids → Doepfer A-101-2 Vactrol LPG
pairings.setup: Choose a simple or harmonically rich Braids model, ping the LPG with short velocity-scaled pulses, and tune resonance below ringing.
pairings.why_it_works: Braids supplies varied spectra while the vactrol response darkens and attenuates each hit as one gesture.
pairings.caution: Bright/noisy Braids models can drive the LPG input hard; reduce level before mistaking distortion for resonance.

insider_note: Documented: some physical models are silent without Trigger; BITS/RATE and internal envelope/VCA live in Setup.
avoid_when: Use Rings for dedicated resonator physics or Model 72/80/84 when coherent component-modeled behavior matters.

name: Mutable Instruments Clouds
comparative_edge: Choose it over Echoes/Tape Echoes when live audio must fragment into grains, freezes, and pitch/time texture rather than repeat cleanly. Choose Parallels for pre-recorded playable waveforms; Clouds is a short streaming buffer processor.

advanced_moves.setup: Modular FX on a familiar loop.
advanced_moves.action: Freeze a transient, set Density near sparse, scrub Position, then tune Size/Pitch and trigger grains externally.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A repeatable playable slice rather than an uncontrolled wash.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Freeze holds buffer while Position/Trig address grains.

advanced_moves.setup: Continuous ambient input.
advanced_moves.action: Set soft Texture window, irregular Density, low feedback, and slowly modulate Position/Size.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A moving cloud without clicks or obvious loop boundaries.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Hann envelopes smooth overlapping grains.

use_cases.application: Scrub and externally trigger selected grains.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More addressable than delay feedback.

use_cases.application: Use soft grains and slow position motion.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Turns streaming audio into time-stretched texture.

pairings.goal: Turn a defined resonant strike into a longer granular environment.
pairings.order: Mutable Instruments Rings → Mutable Instruments Clouds
pairings.setup: Establish a playable Rings voice first, then use restrained Clouds feedback and slow Position/Size motion on an auxiliary path.
pairings.why_it_works: Rings provides pitch and transient identity; Clouds fragments the decaying harmonics into a sustained layer.
pairings.caution: Freeze and high feedback can erase articulation; preserve a dry Rings path.

insider_note: Documented: Density at center emits no grains; Freeze repurposes Feedback into delay/all-pass buildup, and maximum buffer is eight seconds at reduced quality.
avoid_when: Use Echoes for exact rhythmic taps, Tape Echoes for playable feedback, or a sampler for long deterministic playback.

name: 4ms Pingable Envelope Generator
comparative_edge: Choose it over basic Modular envelopes when contour length must derive from clock pings, divide/multiply rhythmically, cycle, and emit stage triggers. It is a timing/control hub, not just amplitude articulation.

advanced_moves.setup: DAW-synced modulation.
advanced_moves.action: Ping from a host division, reset Async each bar, enable Cycle, then tune Skew/Curve and Div/Mult.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A repeatable shaped LFO with bar-aligned phase.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Ping sets period; Async resets phase; Cycle repeats contour.

advanced_moves.setup: Ratcheting envelope chain.
advanced_moves.action: Feed steady Ping, faster pulses to Quantized input, sweep Div CV within bounds, and use EOF to trigger another event.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Tempo-related bursts that resolve cleanly.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Quantized events wait for ping grid and division changes contour length.

use_cases.application: Create tempo-locked skewed contours for a sequenced voice.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Basic ADSRs do not derive duration from pings.

use_cases.application: Chain Quantized and EOF outputs into other modules.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Stage triggers turn one contour into patch timing.

pairings.goal: Build tempo-locked struck contours whose tone and level decay together.
pairings.order: 4ms Pingable Envelope Generator → Doepfer A-101-2 Vactrol LPG CV
pairings.setup: Ping PEG from the host grid, set a short skewed envelope, attenuate its output into the LPG, and cycle only when a repeated pulse is needed.
pairings.why_it_works: PEG controls rhythmic duration while the LPG translates the contour into coupled brightness and amplitude.
pairings.caution: A long PEG contour plus vactrol lag can overlap steps; shorten the contour before increasing tempo.

insider_note: Documented: modeled firmware 4.3 omits two-second tap-clear and System Mode; Quantized triggers wait until the next ping.
avoid_when: Use a simple ADSR when note-gate articulation is enough; PEG adds clock/state complexity.

name: Buchla 259e Twisted Waveform Generator
comparative_edge: Choose it over Braids when a Principal/Modulation oscillator pair, dual timbre-bank morphing, warp, sync, and deliberate code-memory aliasing should interact as one complex voice. Choose Rubicon for cleaner ratioed through-zero analog FM.

advanced_moves.setup: Tonal complex voice.
advanced_moves.action: Choose one low- and one high-harmonic timbre, morph via envelope, then add Mod Index before Warp.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Filter-like spectral travel that stays pitch-centered.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Morph crossfades tables; Warp changes sine drive into each.

advanced_moves.setup: Memory-bank drone.
advanced_moves.action: Select A–C banks, slowly modulate Mem Skew/Morph, mix Mod oscillator audio beneath Principal, and print long takes.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Evolving alias/noise with intentional silences.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Memory banks scan operating-code regions rather than conventional wavetables.

use_cases.application: Morph harmonically related tables with controlled Mod Index.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More internally interactive than Braids.

use_cases.application: Scan A–C banks and print long variations.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its code-memory behavior is unique among Softube oscillators.

pairings.goal: Shape a complex digital oscillator with an organic struck decay.
pairings.order: Buchla 259e Twisted Waveform Generator → Doepfer A-101-2 Vactrol LPG
pairings.setup: Choose a stable timbre pair, keep Warp moderate, and ping the LPG with a short envelope before adding morph motion.
pairings.why_it_works: The 259e supplies evolving harmonics while the vactrol stage couples brightness and loudness into one decay.
pairings.caution: Aliased memory banks can over-excite the LPG; gain-stage before increasing resonance.

insider_note: Documented: A–C banks include noise and frequent silence; in memory mode FM controls are reassigned to Mem Skew.
avoid_when: Use Rubicon for stable through-zero FM, Braids for broad algorithms, or Model synths for conventional subtractive patches.

name: 4ms Spectral Multiband Resonator
comparative_edge: Choose it over Buchla 296e for six tuned resonant bands locked to scales and rotating as chords; choose Rings for one physical body. SMR bridges filter bank, resonator, harmony generator, and spectral-CV source.

advanced_moves.setup: Noise/pulse excitation.
advanced_moves.action: Choose a scale, raise Resonance to ringing, lock anchor bands, then rotate/spread remaining bands with CV.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Harmonic percussion evolving around fixed tones.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Six bandpasses track selected scale positions; locks exempt anchors.

advanced_moves.setup: External loop remix.
advanced_moves.action: Feed loop, lower resonance, rotate bands slowly, and route selected envelope outputs to panning or another filter.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Spectral movement synchronized to source energy.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Per-band followers output control derived from filtered audio.

use_cases.application: Ping six bands and rotate unlocked notes.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More harmonic/chordal than Rings.

use_cases.application: Use band envelopes to modulate downstream processors.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Combines tuned filtering and CV extraction.

pairings.goal: Rotate and articulate tuned resonator bands on a shared rhythmic grid.
pairings.order: 4ms Pingable Envelope Generator → 4ms Spectral Multiband Resonator rotation/spread CV
pairings.setup: Clock PEG from the sequence, use a shallow cyclic contour to move rotation, and lock one or two anchor bands.
pairings.why_it_works: PEG supplies repeatable tempo-shaped movement while the SMR quantizes spectral centers to its selected scale.
pairings.caution: Large CV ranges can skip useful voicings; attenuate modulation and monitor output when resonance is high.

insider_note: Documented: Softube mainly follows firmware v4, adds optional v5-style 1 V/oct envelope outputs, but omits user scales and experimental non-tracking mode.
avoid_when: Use 296e for sixteen-band vocoding/morph memories or Rings for a single modeled resonant body.

name: Doepfer A-101-2 Vactrol LPG
comparative_edge: Choose it over a standard filter+VCA when loudness and brightness should decay together with modeled vactrol lag. Choose Korgasmatron for aggressive dual multimode filtering; A-101-2 specializes in organic struck articulation.

advanced_moves.setup: Sine/triangle oscillator voice.
advanced_moves.action: Select LPG, ping CV with a short pulse, tune Frequency/Resonance, and vary pulse amplitude for dynamics.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Woody plucks whose louder hits are brighter.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: One vactrol contour closes VCA and low-pass together.

advanced_moves.setup: Mode-sequenced texture.
advanced_moves.action: Set L+V/EXT and drive G1/G2 from sequencer gates while feeding a sustained source.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Rhythmic switches among LP, LPG, and VCA behavior.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Gate inputs can sequence operating mode.

use_cases.application: Ping LPG with velocity-scaled pulses.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Coupled spectral/amplitude decay beats separate modules.

use_cases.application: Switch LP/LPG/VCA from G inputs.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Operating mode itself becomes sequence material.

insider_note: Documented: LP input distorts easily; the module passes DC, so vactrol behavior can shape control voltage too.
avoid_when: Use Korgasmatron for precise multimode/stereo aggression or a normal VCA for linear fast amplitude control.

name: Intellijel Korgasmatron II
comparative_edge: Choose it over A-101-2 for driven dual multimode filtering, serial/parallel routing, voltage-controlled crossfade, and self-oscillation. Its 1 V/oct input makes short-range tuned filter voices possible, but Softube documents only about 1.5 octaves of useful tracking.

advanced_moves.setup: Stereo/dual source.
advanced_moves.action: Drive A/B differently, select contrasting filter modes, use parallel routing, then CV crossfade at a slow rate.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Timbre motion without center-level jumps.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Independent driven filters feed a voltage-controlled blend.

advanced_moves.setup: Dual sine voice.
advanced_moves.action: Raise Q to self-oscillation, feed both 1 V/oct inputs, tune an interval within a narrow range, and animate the crossfade.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A two-note sine-like interval that stays usable across roughly one to two octaves.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Both filters self-oscillate and accept pitch CV, but their documented tracking range is limited.

use_cases.application: Filter upper layer in parallel around centered sub.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More flexible/stereo than Model 72 Filter.

use_cases.application: Tune A/B intervals within the documented tracking range and animate crossfade.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Two self-oscillating filters can form one short-range dual voice.

pairings.goal: Turn one precise multi-output oscillator into dual independently driven filter voices.
pairings.order: Intellijel Rubicon outputs → Korgasmatron II A/B
pairings.setup: Send contrasting Rubicon waveforms to the two channels, choose different modes, and animate the crossfade while keeping oscillator pitch fixed.
pairings.why_it_works: Rubicon provides phase-related spectra; Korgasmatron separates their slopes, drive, and resonance before recombination.
pairings.caution: High drive and self-oscillation on both channels can cause large level jumps.

insider_note: Documented: self-oscillating tracking is roughly 1.5 octaves and is best with Q fully clockwise; the 1 V/oct label does not imply full-keyboard oscillator accuracy.
avoid_when: Use A-101-2 for vactrol plucks or Model 72 Filter for one ladder response with envelope following.

name: Intellijel Rubicon
comparative_edge: Choose it over Buchla 259e for precise analog-style through-zero FM, broad simultaneous waveform outputs, sync, symmetry, and sub-octaves. Choose 259e when digital timbre banks and aliasing are the subject.

advanced_moves.setup: Two-oscillator FM voice.
advanced_moves.action: Tune carrier and modulator to a simple ratio with Symmetry fully clockwise, use linear TZFM, then animate Index rather than Symmetry.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Bell/metal sidebands that retain a stable pitch center.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Linear through-zero FM supports ratio-based sidebands, while the documented tracking is best at the normal full-clockwise Symmetry setting.

advanced_moves.setup: Hard-synced lead.
advanced_moves.action: Sync Rubicon from another oscillator, sweep Symmetry and select alternate sine/pulse shapes before filtering.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Harmonic animation without changing played note.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Sync fixes cycle reset while symmetry reshapes outputs.

use_cases.application: Use ratioed TZFM and short envelopes.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: More pitch-stable than 259e memory/timbre modulation.

use_cases.application: Process simultaneous waveforms separately then recombine.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Many outputs expose one coherent phase source.

pairings.goal: Extend a precise through-zero FM voice with separately controllable harmonic folding.
pairings.order: Intellijel Rubicon sine/triangle → Intellijel uFold II
pairings.setup: Stabilize the Rubicon ratio and TZFM index first, then add modest Fold and envelope it independently.
pairings.why_it_works: Rubicon establishes pitch-coherent sidebands; uFold adds a second, patchable nonlinear dimension after the oscillator.
pairings.caution: Complex FM already contains many partials, so heavy folding can become noise-like quickly.

insider_note: Documented: Rubicon is specified at 0.1% tracking over eight octaves only in its intended state; changing Symmetry affects 1 V/oct tracking, which is best with Symmetry fully clockwise.
avoid_when: Use Buchla 259e for dual digital timbre morphing or Braids for many self-contained synthesis algorithms.

name: Intellijel uFold II
comparative_edge: Choose it over distortion when simple waves should gain harmonics dynamically through folding rather than clipping, and over Braids when the waveshaping transfer must stay separately patchable. It pairs naturally with Rubicon but works on any source.

advanced_moves.setup: Sine/triangle voice.
advanced_moves.action: Set conservative Fold, tune Stages/Symmetry, then drive Fold CV from the same velocity envelope that controls a downstream LPG.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Brighter attacks that darken naturally.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Amplitude crosses more folds while LPG couples brightness and level decay.

advanced_moves.setup: Self-feedback noise patch.
advanced_moves.action: Patch Out back to In as documented, route the result immediately through a VCA, then filter or envelope it before monitoring.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A controllable full-range noise source rather than a runaway tonal loop.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The documented output-to-input feedback state makes uFold II generate white noise; downstream gain control makes it usable.

use_cases.application: Envelope Fold and follow with A-101-2 LPG.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Creates dynamic West-coast articulation from basic waves.

use_cases.application: Patch Out to In, control level with a VCA, and shape the result with a filter or LPG.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: The manual documents this self-patch as a full-range white-noise source.

pairings.goal: Turn folded harmonics into a dynamically darkening pluck.
pairings.order: Intellijel uFold II → Doepfer A-101-2 Vactrol LPG
pairings.setup: Start with sine or triangle, use shallow envelope-controlled Fold, then ping the LPG with a related contour.
pairings.why_it_works: The fold increases harmonics near the attack while the vactrol simultaneously closes tone and level.
pairings.caution: Attenuate both CV paths; excessive fold plus LPG input drive can obscure velocity detail.

insider_note: Documented: uFold II can fold audio or CV, and patching its output back to its input creates a full-range white-noise source.
avoid_when: Use a conventional drive for compression/clipping, or Braids when a ready-made digital oscillator algorithm is faster.

name: Amp Room
comparative_edge: Choose Amp Room over a single amp plug-in when the production problem is the whole recorded rig: pedal order, amp, two-cab blend, microphone perspective, parallel lanes, and post processing. Choose the lighter Amplifiers companion when the amp/cab sound is already known and routing experiments would only slow the take.

advanced_moves.setup: Reamp one DI and copy the starting rig into multistates A-D.
advanced_moves.action: Keep amp, gain, and output fixed; change only cabinet and one close mic per state. Match loudness, choose the cabinet on low-mid shape, then move the mic from center toward edge to trade attack for body.
advanced_moves.listen_for: A cabinet that solves most of the mix placement before any parametric EQ.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Cabinet resonance and mic position impose broader, more source-like changes than corrective EQ after the fact.

advanced_moves.setup: In Studio mode, split a bass or baritone-guitar path into low and high lanes.
advanced_moves.action: Leave the low lane clean or lightly compressed; drive the high lane through amp and cabinet. Set the crossover while listening in mono, then use Short Delay or Variable Phase until the combined low mids stop hollowing out.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Stable fundamental weight with distortion that remains audible on small speakers.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The split keeps nonlinear processing away from the sub while Amp Room's alignment utilities repair timing between parallel paths.

insider_note: Documented behavior: Amp Room stores a user IR inside the DAW project and preset, so the session can recall it on another computer even if the original IR file is absent. Only the first second of a loaded WAV is used.
avoid_when: Avoid Amp Room when you need one known amp/cab sound with minimal CPU and setup; use the suite's Amplifiers companion. Avoid Headphone mode during final rendering unless its added room and softened top are intentionally part of the print.

use_cases.application: In Indie rock, use the same amp performance through two different cabinets, keeping one mic near center for pick and the other farther toward the edge for body.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Amp Room makes cabinet and mic contrast a controlled production decision without changing the player's gain response.

use_cases.application: In Drum and bass, send only the band above the sub crossover through a guitar amp/cab lane, then automate cabinet blend between verse and drop.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Studio mode's crossover, parallel routing, and phase tools keep the sub independent while the mids gain physical speaker character.

pairings.goal: Replace a fixed cabinet choice with a continuously shapeable speaker and microphone stage.
pairings.order: Amp/pedals in Amp Room → Celestion Speaker Shaper module → room or post effects
pairings.setup: Bypass the ordinary cabinet, start Speaker Shaper from a real Celestion/default physical configuration, and solve cabinet scale before adding room.
pairings.why_it_works: Amp Room supplies the gain-and-routing ecosystem while Speaker Shaper exposes speaker construction, breakup, and capture as the next production decision.
pairings.caution: The Amp Room module has one speaker and no native room section; add a parallel second module or RoomIR only when needed.

name: American Mainstayer
comparative_edge: Choose it over ENGL Savage for wider, looser American low-end mass and over JMP 2203 for deeper saturation with less upper-mid bark. Its first channel is the better sound-design platform; channel two is the faster route to finished high gain.

advanced_moves.setup: Use channel one with less Gain than a finished metal preset and place TUBE Overdrive before it.
advanced_moves.action: Set pedal Drive low, Level high, and trim lows before the amp; then balance Presence, Master, and Gain instead of maxing Gain alone.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Palm mutes that stop blooming late while sustained chords retain width.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The pedal's documented mid emphasis changes the spectrum driving the deliberately loose channel, while the three amp controls redistribute saturation and high-frequency feedback.

advanced_moves.setup: Duplicate one DI into two Amp Room multistates with the same amp settings.
advanced_moves.action: Pair one oversized V30-style cab for low-mid authority with a tighter, more mid-forward cab; pan only after checking the summed mono tone and phase alignment.
advanced_moves.listen_for: One layer supplies size and the other readable pick attack without a scooped combined center.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Cabinet resonance, not extra amp gain, creates complementary spectral roles while preserving a common distortion envelope.

insider_note: Softube's manual explicitly singles out Presence, Master Volume, and Gain as a productive three-control search space. Engineering inference: auditioning those three before the tone stack prevents post-EQ from compensating for the wrong gain architecture.
avoid_when: Avoid it when extended-range chord separation must stay exact under heavy gain; ENGL Savage is the cleaner choice. For lean punk or classic-rock midrange, JMP 2203 usually occupies less low-frequency space.

sources.title: Softube Amp Room Metal Suite user manual

use_cases.application: In Metalcore, use the tightened first channel for quad tracks at lower gain, reserving channel two for a narrower center reinforcement.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its low-frequency mass survives layering better when split between a tightened wide role and a denser center role.

use_cases.application: In Alternative rock, let channel one remain slightly loose, blend two contrasting cabinets, and automate pedal level rather than amp gain for the chorus.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Mainstayer's imperfect low-end movement sounds larger and less clinically controlled than ENGL when one performance must fill space.

pairings.goal: Tighten low-frequency drive before high-gain clipping while preserving saturation.
pairings.order: TUBE Overdrive → American Mainstayer
pairings.setup: On channel one, keep pedal Drive low, raise Level, trim Tone for pick definition, then reduce amp Gain until chord separation returns.
pairings.why_it_works: The pedal's documented mid emphasis shifts the balance of what reaches Mainstayer’s deliberately loose first channel.
pairings.caution: Do not compensate for the tighter input by adding excessive bass before the amp; restore weight at the cabinet or clean lane.

name: Bass Standard Line V8
comparative_edge: Choose it over Supernova when you want one coherent tube-amp envelope instead of an explicit clean/dirty parallel design, and over Eden WT800 when low-mid bloom and power-stage compression matter more than hi-fi articulation. It also doubles unusually well as a clean guitar amp.

advanced_moves.setup: Split bass into a clean DI and a V8 lane before the amp.
advanced_moves.action: High-pass the V8 lane around the region where the DI becomes solid, push the amp until notes thicken, then blend the V8 only until bass remains readable on small speakers.
advanced_moves.listen_for: The note speaks on phone-size playback without the full-range mix gaining extra sub bloom.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The clean lane owns the fundamental while the tube lane supplies compressed harmonics and low-mid density.

advanced_moves.setup: Feed a bright single-coil guitar into V8 with conservative input drive.
advanced_moves.action: Pair it with a smaller or brighter cabinet than the default bass choices and raise input only until the pick softens.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Large, glassy clean notes with less scoop than Pacific Black and less chime compression than Top Boost.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The 100-watt tube platform has clean headroom and fullness that Softube specifically documents as useful for guitar.

insider_note: Softube explicitly recommends trying the bass amp for sparkling clean guitar. That is more than a novelty: its bass-designed headroom can keep heavily effected guitar transients intact before modulation and reverb.
avoid_when: Avoid it for clean slap, extended-range bass, or detailed bi-amping where Eden WT800 exposes more targeted shaping. Use Supernova when the production needs clean sub and distorted mids inside one purpose-built parallel module.

sources.title: Softube Amp Room Bass Suite user manual

use_cases.application: In Garage rock, keep the DI centered and let a driven V8 lane carry 500 Hz-3 kHz grit under dense guitars.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its tube compression makes aggressive picking consistent without the explicit modern polish of Eden.

use_cases.application: In Dream pop, use V8 as a high-headroom amp before chorus and long reverb, with a compact cabinet to keep modulation lows controlled.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: It stays full under spatial effects without Pacific's deep scoop or Top Boost's pronounced upper-mid compression.

name: Pacific Dual Tremolo 100W Black
comparative_edge: Choose Black over Silver when you want the earlier combo's simpler volume-dependent breakup and sweeter clean-to-hair transition. Choose it over Top Boost for a wider, more scooped pedal platform, and over Custom 100W when rigid British low end would fight the arrangement.

advanced_moves.setup: Start with Volume low enough that Bright still operates and Bass below noon.
advanced_moves.action: Raise Bass and Volume together until the first attractive breakup appears, then back Bass down to recover headroom without losing the selected volume feel.
advanced_moves.listen_for: The attack clears while the note still carries a soft edge and low-mid warmth.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Softube documents that the tone stack—especially Bass—changes the amount of modeled distortion, while Bright works only at lower volume.

advanced_moves.setup: Use the built-in tremolo before a separate spring or chamber reverb.
advanced_moves.action: Set tremolo depth by how much dry center must remain, then time the reverb pre-delay so the first reflection lands after the tremolo's initial dip.
advanced_moves.listen_for: The dry guitar pulses clearly while the reverb fills gaps instead of flattening the motion.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Amplitude modulation before the reverb imprints rhythm on what enters the tail; a small delay lets the unmodulated pick remain localizable.

insider_note: The front-panel 'vibrato' is actually tremolo, and the Bass control changes distortion as well as frequency response. Those two documented quirks explain why conventional clean-amp knob recipes can mislead.
avoid_when: Avoid it when you need to separate preamp and power-stage drive; Silver or Custom exposes that choice. For harmonically dense upper mids and earlier compression, Top Boost is the more decisive voice.

sources.title: Softube Amp Room Vintage Suite user manual

use_cases.application: In Surf rock, keep the amp clean by trimming Bass, use deep tremolo, and place Spring Reverb after the amp for a moving but readable attack.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: The wide American scoop leaves room for spring splash and bass guitar in a way Top Boost's mids do not.

use_cases.application: In Neo-soul, run just below breakup, disable deep tremolo, and let pick velocity produce brief edge on accented chord stabs.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Black's volume-and-tone-stack interaction gives dynamic hair without Silver's extra master-stage decision.

pairings.goal: Create the classic pulsing clean-amp-plus-spring depth without flattening the guitar attack.
pairings.order: Pacific Dual Tremolo 100W Black → Spring Reverb
pairings.setup: Keep the amp clean by trimming Bass, set tremolo first, then add a restrained spring return after the amp.
pairings.why_it_works: The amp’s amplitude motion shapes what excites the spring, while the downstream spring fills the tremolo gaps without altering amp breakup.
pairings.caution: Deep tremolo plus a fully wet spring can remove the dry center; preserve enough direct signal for timing and pitch location.

name: Pacific Dual Tremolo 100W Silver
comparative_edge: Choose Silver over Black when the production needs the same broad American clean family but explicit control over where distortion happens. Its added Master lets you favor tone-stack overdrive or power-stage drive; Black is faster when that distinction is unnecessary.

advanced_moves.setup: Match a clean reference level, then create two states with identical tone controls.
advanced_moves.action: In one state push the tone stack with Master lower; in the other reduce front-end drive and raise Master. Level-match and choose by pick edge versus bloom, not loudness.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Tone-stack drive feels brighter and more immediate; higher Master produces a broader, more yielding envelope.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The Silver model exposes separate control over front-end and power-stage contribution.

advanced_moves.setup: Place a compressor after the amp, before slap delay.
advanced_moves.action: Use slow enough attack to leave the pick, release in time with eighth notes, and only 1-3 dB reduction; use Master for amp feel rather than asking the compressor to create sustain.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Even country-style attacks with audible string snap and no pumping into the slap.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The amp supplies broad clean headroom while the downstream compressor controls performance variance independently.

insider_note: Documented behavior: turning Master down lets the tone stack dominate overdrive; pushing Master brings more power-amp distortion. Treating Master as a simple output trim throws away the model's main advantage over Black.
avoid_when: Avoid Silver when a one-knob clean-to-breakup sweep is the goal; Black is faster. For dense British midrange or obvious channel blending, choose Top Boost instead.

sources.title: Softube Amp Room Vintage Suite user manual

use_cases.application: In Modern country, keep the tone stack mostly clean, use Master for a small amount of give, then add short slap after the amp.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Silver's firmer clean platform lets the producer add controlled sustain without the mid push of Top Boost.

use_cases.application: In Shoegaze, feed a low-mix long reverb into mild tone-stack overdrive while keeping Master moderate, so reflections distort more than the dry transient.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its separate stages let the reverb smear at the front while the power section retains a stable center.

pairings.goal: Build a clean country-style slap that retains pick attack and stereo placement.
pairings.order: Pacific Dual Tremolo 100W Silver → light compression if needed → Stereo Delay
pairings.setup: Keep the amp mostly clean, use a short low-feedback delay after it, and filter repeats before raising their level.
pairings.why_it_works: Silver provides firm clean transients; post-amp delay repeats the finished pick tone without feeding echoes into the amp’s distortion stages.
pairings.caution: Check mono compatibility and do not let the first repeat become louder than the dry pick transient.

name: Custom 100W
comparative_edge: Choose it over Plexi when note separation and low-end authority matter more than soft power-stage bloom, and over Top Boost when a large pedal-friendly platform is preferable to early chime compression. Its grainy preamp and smoother power amp are unusually separable.

advanced_moves.setup: Create two level-matched states with the same cabinet.
advanced_moves.action: For the first, raise Normal Volume and hold Master back; for the second, reduce Normal and push Master. Blend or choose by texture before adding pedals.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Preamp drive has a grainier edge; power-stage drive feels broader and smoother around the note.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: Softube documents the two volume controls as distinct preamp and power-amp distortion stages.

advanced_moves.setup: Feed a wet post-rock guitar part with delays into the amp at low preamp gain.
advanced_moves.action: Raise Master for authority, low-cut only the delay return before it reaches the amp, and keep the dry lane full-range.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Repeats stay separate instead of turning the low mids into one sustained block.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The cleaner front end preserves layered transients while the power stage supplies common density.

insider_note: Softube recommends the low input-gain setting for bass when preamp 'gunk' is not desired. That switch is a production control: it lets the same amp act as a clean foundation or a deliberately dirty mid layer.
avoid_when: Avoid it for soft rectifier sag or singing early breakup; Bluesbreaker and Top Boost reach those behaviors more naturally. For modern high gain, use Mainstayer or ENGL rather than stacking distortion into Custom.

sources.title: Softube Amp Room Vintage Suite user manual

use_cases.application: In Post-rock, use low Normal Volume, higher Master, and a controlled low-frequency delay feed for large chords that remain countable.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its headroom and rigid low end tolerate time effects better than Plexi or Top Boost.

use_cases.application: In Classic rock, select the low input-gain option, drive the power stage more than the preamp, and blend under a clean DI.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Custom's smoother power section adds guitar-like authority to bass without V8's rounder tube-bass bloom.

name: Top Boost
comparative_edge: Choose Top Boost over Pacific when upper-mid chime, early compression, and channel blending should shape the performance; choose Custom 100W when you need firmer headroom. Unlike a simple AC-style preset, this model exposes patched Vib-Trem, Normal, and Brilliant channels as a mixer.

advanced_moves.setup: Classic AC30 hardware move — start with Normal as the dry anchor and both other patched channels down.
advanced_moves.action: Bring in Brilliant until pick definition appears, then add Vib-Trem for drive and motion. If modulation feels too deep, reduce that channel and restore Normal rather than searching for a depth knob.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Chime and motion sit around a stable dry core instead of swallowing it.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The documented modulation depth is fixed; channel blending is the intended wet/dry control.

advanced_moves.setup: Place a boost before the amp with all three channel levels moderate.
advanced_moves.action: Automate boost output between sections while leaving its drive low; reduce amp bass as the chorus boost rises and use the Cut/Tone control last.
advanced_moves.listen_for: More harmonic urgency without a separate, smaller-sounding distortion layer.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The boost changes how hard the amp's tube stages are driven, and the clockwise Tone control then removes excess high end.

insider_note: The Vib-Trem channel contains an extra tube stage before its volume control, making it the most distorted path. Also, the Tone control works backwards by common convention: farther clockwise means less treble.
avoid_when: Avoid Top Boost when the arrangement already has crowded upper mids or needs large, neutral pedal headroom; Pacific Silver or Custom 100W will leave more space. Use a dedicated tremolo if variable modulation depth is essential.

sources.title: Softube Amp Room Vintage Suite user manual

use_cases.application: In Britpop, use more Brilliant on one side and more Normal/Vib-Trem on the other, matching gain but not channel balance.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: The same amp envelope ties the pair together while channel blends create stereo contrast without unrelated cabinets.

use_cases.application: In Afrobeat, anchor with Normal, add a small Brilliant contribution, and keep Vib-Trem low so syncopated attacks remain distinct.
use_cases.why_this_plugin: Its upper-mid compression makes repeated clean figures consistent without a separate heavy compressor.

pairings.goal: Drive the patched channel blend harder without changing its internal balance.
pairings.order: TUBE Overdrive → Top Boost
pairings.setup: Set Normal/Brilliant/Vib-Trem balance first, then use low pedal Drive and automate Level for section lift; reduce amp bass as drive rises.
pairings.why_it_works: The overdrive changes input level and spectral emphasis before all three amp paths while the channel mixer retains the chosen dry/bright/modulated relationship.
pairings.caution: Both pedal and amp emphasize mids; stop when chord density turns nasal rather than adding more post treble.

name: TUBE Overdrive
comparative_edge: Choose TUBE over Kraft when the job is a predictable mid-focused boost that removes low-end slack before an amp. Choose the RAT-style Kraft for fuller low mids, harder clipping, or the wider path from overdrive into fuzzy distortion.

advanced_moves.setup: Classic Tube Screamer-family boost move — place TUBE before a high-gain amp with the amp at the desired saturation but still flubby.
advanced_moves.action: Set Drive near minimum, Level above unity, and Tone just bright enough to expose pick attack; then reduce amp Gain until chord detail returns.
advanced_moves.listen_for: Palm mutes stop blooming after the hit and complex chords regain individual strings.
advanced_moves.why_it_works: The pedal's documented mid emphasis changes the spectral balance driving the amp while Level preserves total drive.

advanced_moves.setup: Use a clean Pacific or Top Boost amp and treat TUBE as the main distortion source.
advanced_moves.action: Raise Drive for sustain, lower Level to avoid unintended amp breakup, and sweep Tone while the full mix plays rather than in solo.
